entries.name: GPIO_read
entries.description: Reads the digital input value (HIGH or LOW) from a specified GPIO pin using digitalRead().

sections.description:
port: The GPIO pin number connected to the digital input device.
INPUT_PULLUP: Configures the pin as an input with an internal pull-up resistor.
Returns HIGH (1) if the pin is HIGH and LOW (0) if the pin is LOW.

entries.name: digitalOutput
entries.description: Controls external components such as LEDs, Laser, or other devices using a digital output signal. The pin can be set HIGH to turn the component ON or LOW to turn it OFF.

sections.description:
In the setup() function configure the port as output:
pinMode(port, OUTPUT);

In the loop() function control the device state:
digitalWrite(port, HIGH);  // Turn device ON
digitalWrite(port, LOW);   // Turn device OFF

port: The external GPIO port where the device is connected. Use the port number according to the hardware documentation.

OUTPUT: Configures the selected port as an output pin.

HIGH: Sets the port voltage HIGH and turns the connected device ON.

LOW: Sets the port voltage LOW and turns the connected device OFF.
These functions do not return any value. They only control the digital state of the selected port.

entries.name: ADC_read
entries.description: Reads the analog input value from a specified GPIO pin using analogRead().

sections.description:
value = analogRead(pin);
Serial.println(value);

pin: The analog input port number.

Example analog input ports from the board:
A1 : 1
A2 : 2
Returns an integer representing the analog input value.

entries.name: pwmOutput
entries.description: Controls external components using PWM signals on a specific pin.

sections.description:
Library Name: ESP32 LEDC PWM (built-in)
Include Syntax: No external library include required.

PWM Function Syntax:
ledcAttach(pin, frequency, resolution);
ledcWrite(pin, duty);

Parameters:
pin: GPIO pin used for PWM output.
frequency: PWM signal frequency in Hz.
resolution: PWM resolution in bits (for example 8-bit gives range 0–255).
duty: PWM duty cycle value.

ledcAttach(pin, frequency, resolution);
Initializes the PWM output on the specified pin.
ledcWrite(pin, duty);

pin: The PWM output port number.
duty: Integer representing the PWM duty cycle value.

Example PWM output ports from the board:
A1 : 1
A2 : 2
No return value. The function sets the PWM duty cycle on the specified pin.

entries.name: imuAccelGyroRead
entries.description: Reads accelerometer, gyroscope, and temperature data from the QMI8658A IMU sensor using I2C communication.

sections.description:
imu.begin(&Wire, SDA_PIN, SCL_PIN);
Initializes the QMI8658A IMU sensor using I2C communication.
imu.readAll(ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz, temp);

ax, ay, az: Accelerometer values in g.
gx, gy, gz: Gyroscope values in degrees per second (dps).
temp: Temperature value from the IMU sensor.
Returns true if sensor data is successfully read.

entries.name: sdAudioPlay
entries.description: Plays an MP3 or WAV audio file from the SD card using I2S audio output.

sections.description:
AudioGeneratorMP3 mp3;
mp3.begin(fileSource, audioOutput);

BCLK: I2S bit clock pin.
LRCLK: I2S left-right clock pin.
DOUT: I2S data output pin.
filename: Audio file path stored on SD card (MP3 or WAV).
Starts playback of the selected audio file through the I2S audio output.

entries.name: servoOutput
entries.description: Controls an external servo motor connected to the board using PWM signals. The servo motor rotates to a specific angle between 0° and 180° by generating the appropriate PWM signal on the connected port.

sections.description:
This example uses the ESP32Servo library to control a servo motor.

1.  Library Name:
	ESP32Servo

2.   Include the library at the beginning of the program:
	#include <ESP32Servo.h>

3.   Library Initialization Syntax:
	Servo servoObject;

4.  Attach the servo to a pin:
	servoObject.attach(port, min_pulse, max_pulse);

5.   Parameters:
	port : The GPIO port where the servo signal wire is connected.
	min_pulse : Minimum pulse width in microseconds (typically around 500).
	max_pulse : Maximum pulse width in microseconds (typically around 2400).

Define the servo port before starting the program:

#define SERVO_PIN 1

SERVO_PIN: The GPIO port where the servo motor control wire is connected. Use the correct external port number according to the hardware documentation.

angle : The position to rotate the servo motor, specified in degrees (0–180).

SERVO_PIN : The GPIO port connected to the servo signal wire.
These functions do not return any value. They generate a PWM signal that moves the connected servo motor to the specified angle.

entries.name: sdCarWrite
entries.description: Writes and reads text data from a file stored on the SD card using the SD_MMC interface.

sections.description:
clk: SD clock pin.
cmd: SD command pin.
d0: SD data pin.
filename: Name of the file stored on the SD card.
FILE_WRITE: Opens the file in write mode.
FILE_READ: Opens the file in read mode.
Returns a File object. If the file opens successfully, data can be written or read.

entries.name: sdCardCRead
entries.description: Reads text data from a file stored on the SD card using the SD_MMC interface and prints it to Serial.

sections.description:
clk: SD clock pin.
cmd: SD command pin.
d0: SD data pin.
filename: Name of the file stored on the SD card.
FILE_READ: Opens the file in read mode.
Returns a File object. If the file opens successfully, data can be read from it.

entries.name: serialServoAngleChange
entries.description: Moves a serial bus servo to a specified angle by sending position commands through UART communication.

sections.description:
Serial1.begin(BAUDRATE, SERIAL_8N1, RX_PIN, TX_PIN);
Initializes UART communication with the serial servo.
DS_ServoMove(id, position, time);

id: Servo ID number.
position: Target servo position value.
time: Time in milliseconds for the servo to reach the position.
Sends a command packet to the servo to change its position.

entries.name: serialServoAngleRead
entries.description: Reads the current angle of a serial bus servo using UART communication and prints the angle in degrees.

sections.description:
Serial1.begin(115200, SERIAL_8N1, RX_PIN, TX_PIN);
Initializes UART communication with the serial servo.
int postion = DsServoReadPosition(id);
id: Servo ID number to read the current position of the serial servo.
Returns the servo postion value.
